scripts.test:changed:main: firebase emulators:exec --project activitypub-firebase-dev --only firestore "cross-env GCLOUD_PROJECT=activitypub-firebase-dev vitest run --changed origin/main"
scripts.measure:reads: firebase emulators:exec --project activitypub-firebase-dev --only firestore "cross-env GCLOUD_PROJECT=activitypub-firebase-dev vitest run --config vitest.measure.config.ts"
